claims.text: West of Khonsu’s temple in the southwest Amun precinct.
The temple includes an elevated sanctuary and crypts associated with Osiris. Its small hall has Hathor-headed columns.
A rear shrine opposite a Khonsu temple doorway suggests a ritual relationship; it does not demonstrate a currently usable passage.
Digital Karnak’s phase account explicitly warns that the modeled sequence is simplified. Consult newer architectural publications before assigning the whole building to one ruler.
